name: label-echo
when: Products whose LABEL is the design argument: heritage brands, serif lockups, apothecary/craft packaging, luxury. The type echoes the label's world instead of imposing ours.
accent_jobs: hairline rule (2px) drawn under the hero
small-caps kicker in the accent color
notes: Mixed case on the hero (serif upper-only reads as a bank). The kicker alone is uppercase. Reveals are slower (0.8-0.9s) — elegance is tempo.
